sloka: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं सर्वे ते भेजिरे दिशः।भीमं मीमाक्षमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा वानरयूथपाः ।। ६.६६.३१ ।।
transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanaṁ sarve te bhejire diśaḥ।bhīmaṁ mīmākṣamāyāntaṁ dṛṣṭvā vānarayūthapāḥ ।। 6.66.31 ।।

translations.english: All the Vanara troops having replied that way, seeing Kumbhakarna of frightful eyes coming towards them, scattered in all directions.
